modules.name: Welcome to the Innovation Skills Accelerator Cours...
modules.description:
Welcome to the Innovation Skills Accelerator Course!

Based on research with thousands of public servants across three continents, our problem-solving curriculum gives you the digital, data and innovation skills to deliver more effective, equitable and engaged policies and services. 


This course is presented by Professor Beth Simone Noveck.


Beth Simone Noveck is a professor at Northeastern University, where she directs the Burnes Center for Social Change and its partner project, The GovLab. In 2019, Beth was appointed the State of New Jersey’s first Chief Innovation Officer by Governor Phil Murphy, where her team are using new technology to improve equitable government delivery of services. Previously, Beth served in the White House as the first United States Deputy Chief Technology Officer under President Obama

name: 1. Innovation Mindset
summary:
Innovation Mindset

This module introduces the concept of public problem solving - a set of strategies to understand problems and to take solutions from idea to implementation.

After each video in this module you will find 3 self-assessment questions to respond to. Remember to answer them to complete the module and receive your badge! 

Happy learning!

Do you have questions? Send an email to hello@innovate-us.org

name: 2. Introduction to Problem Definition
summary:
Introduction to Problem Definition

This module introduces the concept of problem definition, why it matters, and will teach viewers how to effectively define a problem, including developing a hypothesis, defining root causes, and reframing the problem. 

After each video in this module you will find 3 self-assessment questions to respond to. Remember to answer them to complete the module and receive your badge!

Data Analytical Thinking

name: Course Completion Certificate
summary:
You did it!

After 15 modules, 38 videos, worksheets and readings, you have completed the course modules.  Remember, you will only be able to access the certificate if you have completed all the required activities in the earlier modules. 

You can claim your final certificate by clicking below. 

You will also receive a copy of the certificate by email. 

Keep an eye out for future emails from us about feedback, user interviews, and next steps. We would be very appreciative if you completed a user interview and provided us with feedback. If you want to keep learning and building your skillset, check out the library of past live workshops and sign up for a future session on our website. 

If you are unable to access your certificate even after completing all the modules,  get in touch with us at hello@innovate-us.org
